title: Feature Module Scaffold Compiler
description: Compiles feature folder structure with public barrel exports, enforces no cross-feature private imports, and verifies every declared capability has a corresponding file.

error_codes.FM002: index.ts missing or has no exports — public barrel required
error_codes.FM003: Declared capability has no corresponding file in feature directory
error_codes.FM004: Cross-feature import bypasses public index.ts — must import from barrel
error_codes.FM005: Internal file exported via barrel — only public API should be in index.ts
